summary: New box Part. Pass.: example for sense 1 in Part. Pass. (Jan 2.35/5589)

data.turoyo: <...> Kul kṯowo m diḏan m šanṭəro b xaṣrayo, kul yaḏoʕo m diḏan, aḏiʕət, nəxroye w bas kuḏaʕle w aḥna lə kuḏʕinale.
data.translation: <...> Each book of ours is scattered on one side, each knowledgeable person of ours, you know, foreigners alone know him and we do not know him.

rationale: First Detransitive Part. Pass. box and explicit dispersed-state sense, distinct from round-1 active flinging. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; analysis rests on the Turoyo.
Each book is located separately on one side; m šanṭəro describes a dispersed state with no expressed scattering agent. One attestation; new Detransitive section, with inherited active I retained.

data.turoyo: Mədle l ʕAli l droʕa, mšantrole,
data.translation: Da packte Ali sie am Arm, schleuderte sie wütend auf die Erde

rationale: Thin Preterit sense-1 cell: first fully contextualized textual example alongside the inherited bare form.

summary: The overt l-marked agent Ali is resumed by the Preterit ending; the female patient is incorporated in mšantrole. The preceding arm-grasping clause makes the object recoverable.
Retain the glossary's stem I label for this quadriliteral. The token confirms the existing throwing/flinging sense, without an additional construction or idiom.
The German supplies anger and direction to the ground; these are retained as the edition's contextual translation, not added to the core lexical gloss.

The written discussion of dispersed books and knowledgeable people extends the physical result of flinging to distribution of cultural resources. It supports a Detransitive state, not a new technical library sense.
Preserve the source’s space in m šanṭəro and emphatic ṭ beside inherited šntr/t. No source normalization or automatic root reassignment is made.
Keep the inherited stem I label, as round 1 did for this longer root. Only a provisional Part. Pass. state is attested here; no finite Detransitive base forms are reconstructed.
Confirm the segmentation of mšantrole's patient and agent endings against the entry's base mšantalle; the attested spelling is retained.
Confirm segmentation of m šanṭəro, its ṭ/t correspondence and Part. Pass. status rather than a lexical adjective or another formation.
Does the distributive every book on one side imply physical scattering or merely separated locations? The proposed state gloss avoids inferring violent throwing.
